svg.text: A clear cup of water goes between the
blue LED and the photoresistor. The LED
shines THROUGH the water at the sensor.
Cover LED + cup + sensor with a box.
D7 lights the LED; A1 reads the light (10k to GND).
Practice light sensor: blue LED on D7 shines through a cup of water onto a photoresistor read on A1
The stage 1 + stage 2 alerter is unchanged. The yellow boxes and yellow-glow wires are NEW.
1. LDR (photoresistor) has no polarity: either way round.
